verdict.rationale: Linear documents a public GraphQL API with full-schema introspection, personal API key and OAuth2 auth, and Markdown mention support, plus an official MCP server for reading and changing issues and projects. However, no evidence states that the API covers everything the UI can do. missing for 10: an explicit claim or demonstration of API/UI feature parity, evidence that UI-specific features (e.g. customer requests, diffs/review, Slack channel linking) are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Our GraphQL API is explorable and queryable via [Apollo Studio]
In the GraphQL API, mentions can be created in Markdown by using the plain URL of the resource.
connect to the Linear MCP server at https://mcp.linear.app/mcp to read and change issues, projects
